name: Arbolito
description: Arbolito is an autonomous cambista (money-changer) agent on Celo. In Telegram (es/pt/en, voice notes) it holds, converts and sends wARS, wBRL and USA₮, routing through the best mix of Textile RFQ firm quotes and Uniswap v3, and anchors a verifiable ProofBundle receipt onchain for every route. Other agents can hire it through an x402 FX API (quote, convert, send; payable in USA₮, USDC, USDT, wARS, wBRL or wCOP) or the arbolito-mcp server.
